MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 22
   D. 88

3. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 13
   C. 9
   D. 12

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

6. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 8

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

10. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 30

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 49

16. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 5

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

18. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 5

19. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

20. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

21. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 3

22. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 37
   D. 13

23. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 65

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
